decision.reason: Only Bearing3_2 retained strong positive Level ordering; Bearing3_1 and Bearing3_3 had negative Spearman correlations, while Bearing3_2 produced a 0.1396 Movement event fraction under the frozen Condition 1 threshold.

validity_scan.simpsons_paradox: Per-bearing results are reported; no pooled correlation is used because trajectories are heterogeneous.
validity_scan.ecological_fallacy: The bearing is the evaluation unit; time points are not treated as independent devices.
validity_scan.berkson_bias: Run-to-failure laboratory bearings are selected trajectories and may not represent deployed populations.
validity_scan.collider_bias: No covariate-conditioned causal comparison is claimed.
validity_scan.base_rate_neglect: Movement event fractions differ strongly by bearing, so threshold crossings are not called faults.
validity_scan.regression_to_mean: No before-after intervention effect is claimed.
validity_scan.survivorship_bias: Complete run-to-failure records do not cover field censoring or maintenance removal.
validity_scan.look_elsewhere_effect: Metrics and bearings were preregistered before Condition 3 data access.
validity_scan.researcher_degrees_of_freedom: Artifacts, parameters, split and threshold were hash-frozen before access.
validity_scan.correlation_causation: Level-time correlations are descriptive and do not establish physical damage causation.
validity_scan.reverse_causality: Chronology is respected, but no causal mechanism is inferred from it.

next_step: Use only Bearing3_1-Bearing3_3 to compare adaptation candidates; freeze one candidate before Bearing3_4 validation and keep Bearing3_5 for one-time final testing.
